description: Native single-instrument P&L attribution of a convertible bond whose credit spreads widen from 150bp to 300bp over one day, under the four Rust methods (attributePnlMany), with Rust's explain text, residual check and share of total per factor. `workbench` attributes the results-fixture bond from its market and date to the market of a market-scenario case (the workbench P&L explain); the markets themselves are not stored.
